div.div: دُوَامٌ (tropical:) A vertigo, or giddiness in the head; i. q. دُوَارٌ (S, * M, * K, TA. [In the CK, دَواءٌ is erroneously put for دُوَارٌ.]) You say, أَخَذَهُ دُوَامٌ (tropical:) [A vertigo took him, or attacked him]. (S.) And بِهِ دُوَامٌ (tropical:) [He has a vertigo]. (As, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
